questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: In frames 7 through 12, where the board is fully or mostly visible, exactly three pens are clearly arranged in a row.
In all frames where pens are visible (e.g., frames 7-12), all three pens are oriented with the black cap at the bottom and the clear barrel at the top.
All three pens have translucent barrels and black caps, appearing identical in color and style.
All pens appear to have their black caps on the bottom end, and they are of equal length.
The board moves steadily from the left edge (frame 1) to the right edge (frame 16) without pausing or reversing.
The pens maintain their relative spacing and position on the board throughout the movement.

parsed.reason: The board moves smoothly from left to right carrying exactly three identical pens, all oriented in the same direction with caps on, satisfying all nominal conditions.

description: Mid-clip, the pens themselves shift/move on their own due to an unseen external force; the board moves normally and no cause is visible in the scene.
